notes.title: The Story Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/109d2f90ee1111f07e0cae8cddcce246adf1f6d8.png

BEHOLD Wish Seekers!

To the actual final finisher update for Wish World.
This is possibly the biggest update added to the game.

Here's a Major game changing update!

Patch Notes:

Major update!

 Full Controller Support.
 NPC dialogue system has been completely re-vamped!
 Added many more NPCs into different levels and almost over 300 different pieces of text with story and more.
 Added new songs to certain levels.
 Certain levels have a chance to spawn rain.
 Lava Lake has been changed to be more unique and interesting compared to other levels.
 Updated many level layouts.
 Fixed a lighting issue with NPC Campfires.
 Made it impossible to take damage after kicking an enemy, and kicked enemies give lives upon death.
 Added a door to leave levels at the start of each level. (besides the final new level)
 Re-vamped the rock couples models.
 Added more Charm.
 Added a vendor that sells Lives that costs coins. (it gives coins more of a use)
 Fixed navigator of enemies in levels.
 Other small tweaks and changes (Too many to list)
 Added another plane Under the Wish Plane.
 Added stone tablets with story elements.
 The Hotdog Seller has a limit on his hotdogs and more than 1 can be purchased.
 Now each NPC has a Unique sound effect when talking.
 Added 3 new achievements.
 Added the ability to read graves.
 Made the HUD more user-friendly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/aaa80d4a1ea6299ae19d96ade703a6faaa323340.png
 Updated the Menu/options/pausing HUDs to make them easy to read and navigate.
 Added a brief intro to the game and ending cut-scene to the game.
 Added some unique sound effects.
 Added one final ultra difficult level that combines everything in Wish World in one final level.


Thank you for any new players coming in or older players for supporting Wish World. Being a solo developer isn't easy but its so enjoyable hearing the feedback from people who end up playing and enjoying the game.

This I think is the final update probably last update ;) (I think) To be for Wish World.

If you enjoy the update, Please Give it a Review. and invite your friends to try the game!
Wish Seekers Thank you for being you. Seriously. See you in the next game! <3

The second project I was working on I have also finished and will be uploaded to steam soon.

Thank you so much for being with Wish World!
And Remember - "Keep Striving For Greatness!" ~Ryan :)

notes.title: Wish World 2.0 Is HERE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/04d9f44f346d7df44b6136d5494f589d52941978.png

Welcome Wish Seekers!

Its been a journey, however it is not over for Wish World!
Upon uploading the 2.0 trailer It suddenly exploded and a brand new influx of people have been playing the game, I was so thrilled, I decided You know what ANOTHER UPDATE!

Patch Notes:

Major Changes!


 Added 7 New Bonus levels that use features that where under shadowed.
 Added a new extra small Island added to the hub world for all 10 Bonus Levels.
 The game should now save your progression upon each update or reinstall, if not oops.


Small Changes!


 Added text upon starting the game explaining the goal of playing the game to new players!
 Fixed a number of errors involving the character.
 Added something under.
 Added other small fixes and optimisations.


A previous review stated they wished for more movement based levels that would be difficult instead of the regular difficulty spike within the game, I decided that wasn't right and went back and added another 7 new difficult bonus levels that use features not used very much within Wish World such as the fans, flip things or ice for example.

These 7 new levels are in my opinion much harder than the expert levels so good luck to you, you will be rewarded an achievement for your efforts <3

And Finally...

-Thank you for Supporting me. Its funny writing that as I'm just one dude, but the support on the game recently got me thrilled so I decided to add another update to the game and a brand new achievement for those achievement hunters. 

Good luck beating the 7 new levels they are pretty tough.

I'm actually in the development of my second project, It will have a much better game play loop and will be less speed run Focused.

Thank you for playing, but remember Please Give it an honest Review. People Should Try the game!

Wish Seekers Thank you for being you. Seriously. See you in the next game/update! <3

And Remember - "Keep Striving For Greatness!" ~Ryan :)

notes.title: Wish World OverHaul!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/78f446aea101bbd7dc30a5967884875bcc075b5f.png

Welcome Wish Seekers!

Its been a journey, however this "may be" the final update for Wish World.
The game is Finally Always what I intended to create. 

Here's a Major game changing update!

Patch Notes:

Major update!

 When inside of a expert level the Player CAN NOW; Dive Forward -but Cannot; Dive down or wall-hop.
 Jumping off of a wall can now be done twice before landing on the ground.
 Visual Changes added to all levels to make each one feel more unique and memorable.
 Changes in volume for sound effects.
 More Secret Lore Added.
 Changed certain level layouts and removed Wind from the game completely.
 Final Level has been changed to be more expansive and challenging. 
 Campfires Appear near some NPC's.
 Lighting Changes to certain levels to make them Beautiful Just like you :)
 Changed Hit-boxes for lots of the traps.
 Added Invincibility frames.
 Changes to the HUB World.
 Sound Additions to all levels.
 Fixed an issue with loading now working when you deleted your save then re-saved.
 Added an Auto save feature.
 Your save File now automatically loads upon starting the game.
 Deleting your save no longer force closes the game.
 Expert Levels are Easier and Harder?


Thank you for Supporting JoyArk Studios. I had a blast creating Wish World and It took over 4-5 Years to complete. It was worth it. I was close to failing at life, but this game, this small game that no one will know about saved my life, and as corny as this sounds I hope it saves someone else's too.

I'm actually in the development of my second project, It will have a much better game play loop and will be less speed run Focused.

If you supported the game, Please Give it a Review. People Should Try the game.
Wish Seekers Thank you for being you. Seriously. See you in the next game! <3

And Remember - "Keep Striving For Greatness!" ~Ryan :)
